### Page 935 - Official Gazette

#### Article 72
1. The Council of Ministers, in special cases, is empowered to direct the formation of a committee responsible for preparing recommendations to the Minister and the Ministerial Committee regarding the purchase of specific goods necessary for the government body if the conditions and qualifications for this project are met.
2. It can be concluded that if it stipulates the conditions for its establishment regarding the number of members, it will not exceed five, provided that the committee is chaired by a senior official from the government body and a board member of the central administration.
3. The committee’s functions under this article will conclude with the completion of its work or the issuance of a decision regarding the budgetary provisions or issuing a legal decree concerning it.
4. The assembly of the committee stipulated in this article (1) must include four of its members, and it must be noted that the opinions of the committee members are considered in its recommendations on the aforementioned and in case of disagreements, they are referred to the head of the committee in this.

#### Article 73
1. The activities related to those functions and the services that the government body requires are conducted within the two following committees:
   - A. Purchase Committee.
   - B. Main Purchase Committee.

#### Article 74
1. The General Authority shall constitute a Purchase Committee in any branch of the unit, including five members from its employees who primarily engage in the purchases required for its functions.
2. The activities that are not to be included shall amount to five million (5,000,000) for services that are not to be included on the budget.
3. The committee requests the assembly of its members to meet under the legal framework to ensure that they have the necessary expertise.
4. The Minister of Finance shall approve the resolutions of this committee.

#### Article 75
1. The Minister shall establish a main committee to oversee the purchase at the center of the government units, consisting of four employees from the government body, known as the head of the unit, who will vote on the decisions of this committee.
